title: Jeff GET /v1/adapters response (also PUT /v1/adapters/served and POST /v1/adapters/reload)
description: Every adapter in the catalogue trained for the base the engines serve (its manifest's base id and version are the engines' base: the rule an engine refuses an adapter by), marked served or not, with its one-line description and its functions; an adapter trained for another base is not listed, since no engine here can serve it, and PUT /v1/adapters/served refuses it as before (404 UnknownFunction). Each function's full detail (labels, context, input, calibration) is in GET /v1/functions. adapters_version is an opaque change counter -- the sum of the engines' own counters, each counting its own served-list changes from 0 -- that goes up whenever any engine's served list changes. It can go DOWN when an engine process restarts, because that engine's own counter resets to 0. Compare it only to a value read earlier from the same deployment to notice that something changed; never use it to count how many changes happened, or compare it across deployments.

aliases.description: The other names the adapter answers to, as its manifest lists them: short names (triage) and, for an adapter whose ID has a version part, its unversioned ID (jeff.routing.router-open for jeff.routing.router-open-v14).

description.description: The adapter's one-line description, as its manifest writes it (hub.summary); the server refuses to load a manifest without one.

functions.description: The adapter's functions, in its manifest's order.

id.description: The function's ID (adapter ID, a dot, the function's key).

calibrated.description: Whether it has a threshold for the base the engines serve: its calibration on a bfloat16 base, its calibration_by_format entry for the base's format_id on an INT4 base.

served.description: Whether every engine in this deployment currently serves this adapter.
